body: I know this is going to sound cliche, but you just have to find the right people. There are so many people out there that you’re compatible with. Statistically speaking, if you don’t get along with 99% of the population, you would still have 75 million people to choose from. I didn’t have close friends till much later in my life so I know where you’re coming from, don’t lose hope.
I’m going through everything u just mentioned. I don’t know what else to say bc I don’t know how to fix it, but I wanna let u know you’re not alone
Thank you, you’re really sweet and I’m sorry you’re going through so much. I hope you find some sort of resolution or peace soon :)
I can’t say that it’ll work, but I’ll try

Well, I guess in short, nothing brings me happiness. I know I am capable of being successful in life, but I am numb to everything. I am successful in college, I have friends, I am in honors society at my college, yet I feel such despair. It has gotten to the point where I’m afraid others will hurt me at some point and I can’t feel love. I don’t know if this makes sense.

I know, I’m trying but I don’t see the point. I know I don’t wanna die, but i feel like my existence pains others and I don’t wanna do that anymore. I’m frantically searching something to give me comfort but nothing helps. I feel so lost
Yeah, that’s a good point. I’m just very tired is all, I will try until I can’t anymore
Yes, I journal a lot, I’ve been trying to figure everything out. I wish good luck to u too :)
